sources.topic: Alert defaults and XML queue/deferred attachment lifecycle
Predefined message types, priority and deferred attachment/MD behavior

contract.alerts: Explicit defaults and local outbox, blank default address/URL preserved as data
contract.xml: Bounded UTF-8 well-formed XML without DTD/entities; source deleted only after access/publication preflight; native schema opaque
contract.attachments: Capture paths now, read current bytes only on host collection; preflight full batch, delete ordinary files, retain MD
contract.zdt: Explicit types and replaceable selections; host publish snapshots attachments with opaque bytes; no implicit SET_VAR trigger
contract.backends: Exact MemoryFiles and DeviceFiles only; busy, mount and read-only checks; preserve device garbage accounting
contract.limits: Shared compact JSON content budget and bounded collection result; priority metadata only; monotonic bounded sequences
contract.persistence: Checked schemas, defaults, types, pending selections and all three outbox kinds; detached snapshots and explicit collection

boundaries: No network, email, SMS, mobile application, native ZDT schema/trigger or controller access
No DirectoryFiles/custom file callback deletion, scheduled dispatch, transport acknowledgement or crash journal
No native status/timing equivalence; strict mode deferred
